title: 1. Regional Sales Growth
paragraph: A retail company tracks its sales (in ₹ lakhs) across four regions for the years 2022 and 2023. Study the table and answer the questions that follow.

questions.text: What is the total sales of all regions in 2023?
What percentage of total 2023 sales came from the North region?
What is the ratio of North to South sales in 2022?
What is the difference between 2023 and 2022 sales for the East region?
What is the average 2022 sales across all regions?

title: 2. Bank Branch Loan Disbursement
paragraph: A bank disbursed loans (in ₹ crores) of three types across four branches last quarter. Study the table and answer the questions that follow.

questions.text: What is the total Home Loan disbursement across all branches?
What percentage of total Auto Loan disbursement came from Branch3?
What is the ratio of Personal Loans disbursed by Branch2 to Branch4?
What is the difference between Home Loans and Auto Loans disbursed by Branch1?
What is the grand total of all loans (all types, all branches) disbursed?

title: 3. Student Examination Scores
paragraph: Five students appeared for exams in Math, Science and English (marks out of 100). Study the table and answer the questions that follow.

questions.text: What is the total Math score across all students?
What is the average Science score across all students?
Which student scored the highest in English, and what was the score?
What is the ratio of Aisha's Math score to Rahul's Math score?
What is the difference between Priya's Math and English scores?

title: 4. Manufacturing Plant Production
paragraph: Three manufacturing plants report their production (in units) for two quarters. Study the table and answer the questions that follow.

questions.text: What is the total Q1 production across all plants?
What percentage of total Q2 production came from PlantB?
What is the difference between PlantC's Q1 and Q2 production?
What is the ratio of PlantA's to PlantC's Q1 production?
What is the average Q2 production across all plants?

title: 5. Household Monthly Expenditure
paragraph: A family recorded its monthly expenditure (in ₹) on Food, Rent, Transport and Savings for four months. Study the table and answer the questions that follow.

questions.text: What is the total Savings across all four months?
What percentage of the four-month total Food expenditure was spent in March?
What is the average Transport expenditure across the four months?
What is the difference between Rent and Food expenditure in January?
Which month had the highest Savings, and what was the amount?
